subject: Partner gateway activation: kickoff & enablement plan
messages:
From: Eva Morales <eva.morales@brightgate.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightGate x Redwood - initial onboarding questions

Hi Kimberly / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week. BrightGate is excited to move forward with a proof-of-value that integrates our intake forms with Redwood's hosted inference for semantic enrichment. Before we lock a kickoff date, can you help with a couple quick items so we can scope the SI enablement on our side?

1) What does your standard partner onboarding cadence look like (technical readiness, enablement, handoff)?
2) Can you share a short checklist of pre-kickoff items BrightGate should complete (API access, test dataset, firewall/IP allowlist)?
3) Any recommended pre-read or short training you expect partners to consume ahead of the first workshop?

I've attached a one-pager of our use case and a few sample payloads. Happy to hop on a call if that's easier.

Thanks,
Eva Morales
Partner Lead, BrightGate Consulting
partners@brightgate.com
[Attachment: BrightGate_Onboard_Qs.pdf]
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Eva Morales <eva.morales@brightgate.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightGate x Redwood - initial onboarding questions

Eva — thanks for the summary and the payloads; this looks straightforward. Below is the typical lightweight onboarding we use for consultancies doing an integration-first PoV. I included next steps and owners so we can move quickly.

High-level cadence (recommended):
- Week 0: Pre-kickoff (access, allowlist, share sample datasets) — owner: BrightGate + Aditya (technical lead)
- Week 1: Integration workshop (API walkthrough, auth, error modes, KV/prefix caching patterns) — owner: Redwood enablement + BrightGate engineers
- Week 2: Joint validation (end-to-end tests, performance targets, simple evals) — owner: BrightGate + Redwood SRE
- Week 3: Handoff & playbook (deployment patterns, recommended quantization / batching config, rollback) — owner: Partnerships + BrightGate

Pre-kickoff checklist (quick):
- Confirm IPs to allowlist (we'll give the ranges)
- Create a sandbox API key (we'll provision)
- Provide representative sample payloads (10-30 items)
- Identify 1-2 test endpoints and success criteria (latency, accuracy bands)

Recommended pre-read / assets:
- Redwood partner quickstart (10 min) — link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cPartnerOnboard
- Short deck: Partner activation & integration expectations (attached)

Attachments: redwood-partner-activation-deck-v1.pptx

Proposed next steps:
1) Aditya and your engineer do a 30-min technical match on Mon/Thu this week — propose Mon 9/15 10:00 PT?
2) We'll provision a sandbox API key once you send the allowlist and sample payloads.

I'll let Aditya comment on the technical slot. Happy to adjust cadence to BrightGate's needs.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood-partner-activation-deck-v1.pptx]
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightGate x Redwood - initial onboarding questions

Looping in a few enablement artifacts and a short technical pre-checklist so Aditya has what he needs.

Technical pre-checklist for Aditya to confirm before provisioning sandbox key:
- Confirm BrightGate outbound IP ranges (for our allowlist)
- Confirm sample payload shape and max token estimates
- Confirm whether they plan to use streaming or non-streaming responses
- Any PII concerns or data residency notes (we'll flag for Privacy team if needed)

I've uploaded a brief MOP for connector wiring and a one-hour workshop agenda to the partner folder. See link + stub below.

- Workshop agenda: 60-min integration lab (API auth, sample request/response, KV caching demo, simple eval)
- MOP stub: connector-mop-v1.md (includes curl samples and troubleshooting tips)

Aditya — if you can confirm availability for Mon 15 Sep 10:00 PT, I'll block a 60-min slot and share calendar invites and the workshop agenda.

Thanks — Laura
Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: connector-mop-v1.md]
